dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Welcome to the gym! Are you interested in a membership?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I would like to start exercising regularly.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Great. What is your main goal: losing weight, or getting stronger?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I want to get stronger and have more energy during the day.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Then I recommend three sessions a week with a trainer at the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much does the membership cost for a month?

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: It is thirty-five a month, and the first session is free.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That sounds reasonable. Can I try the equipment today?

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Of course. Our trainer will show you how everything works.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do I need to bring my own towel?

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Yes, please bring a towel and a bottle of water.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. I will sign up right now.
